assessment: The actual neutral transition round passed its configuration and recovery gates. It operated on the matching 0.10.1 / serial 5054316560DD729C device from revision 1, profile 4, physical_mask 0; only two set_active_profile requests occurred (4→1→4), reaching revision 3, with profile 4 restored and serial closed. The before/after schema2 exports are both 1387 bytes; all bytes except revision offsets 4–7 match, and original-profiles.json is byte-identical. No save, Flash, or reboot request is present. ETW captured 5183 events with zero reported loss under PartialDataBusTrace on the three USB3 stack providers; target UCX transfer summaries show four successful endpoint-0x83 completions of length 29 and four successful endpoint-0x84 completions of length 6. This verifies neutral-sized interrupt transport at the host stack (transport_verified=true), but report bytes remain unverified (report_bytes_verified=false): the complete trace has no target payload-byte event. Do not infer an all-zero report from transfer lengths. This is not a physical key/motion, GET_REPORT, Hall, XY, or game test.
